begin.frame: 512-byte header followed by root_path_bytes exact UTF8 path bytes, no terminating NUL
begin.owner: parent supplies existing authenticated connection owner ID; never from user arguments
begin.read_target: only original request_status/request_result target; native checks retained record sameowner before pinning
begin.request_id: native audit generates32 bytes getrandom and lowercasehex64; no caller-provided ID in v1

custody.ancestor: native walks exact UTF8 root path with NOFOLLOW/O_PATH ancestry and verifies state_dir_fd identity
custody.archive_only: admit archive-only if no inactive archived-equal hotvictim
custody.held_fds: daemon shares actual root/legacy/legacy-anchor/v12-root/v12-anchor/256-shard FDs across live tickets; each slot retains its actual hot-directory FD, original record identity, read pin and monotonic start
custody.shared_layout: a later begin may finish and validate original v12 initialization into the shared held directory set; old flat tickets use that same completed set; an unvalidated external layout change still refuses old completion
custody.shared_memory: only32 live worker slots; archive population unbounded by slotcount; inactive stale slots reclaimed only after worker lease check

encoding: little-endian u64 words; fixed ASCII identifiers; no host semantic owners
process: one native daemon per controller lifetime; AF_UNIX SOCK_SEQPACKET socketpair, daemon stdin/stdout on one blocking endpoint; prepare, begin and finish responses do not exit the daemon; controller death is fenced with PR_SET_PDEATHSIG plus parent-PID reread
queries: v1 transport covers prepare/begin_with_read/finish; standalone history/usage/archive read protocol will be separately versioned, not falsely reported implemented

bytes_fields.192..447: UTF8 component error text zero-padded256; complete original malformed-error-string equivalence is not claimed by the component case gate

response.cancel: worker SIGKILL releases its byte64+slot lease; daemon reaps expired actual ticket FDs on the next packet and leaves the previously durable Unknown record unchanged; controller death kills the daemon; cancellation never synthesizes Failed
response.failure: prepare refusal/system failure emits one complete response then exits65/74; later begin/finish refusal emits one response and preserves the daemon for other slots; socket/write failure ends the daemon; no automatic operation replay
response.success: one exact512-byte packet; prepare success remains alive, begin success authorizes dispatch, finish success completes the same actual ticket and remains alive

u64_fields.32: stable component reason code; nonzero if failure

shared.worker_lease: worker PID holds one-byte F_WRLCK at 64+slot for the complete dispatch; daemon verifies F_GETLK l_pid equals the supplied worker_pid, not the daemon parent PID; worker must not close any FD for this memfd inode before its dispatch lease ends

transport.client_endpoint: O_NONBLOCK; caller serializes send plus matching response with byte1 POSIX lease
transport.stale_response: parent validates a complete basic response then discards old phase/slot/generation packets until its own response; no automatic business retry
